headline: Eight US states sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT is an unsafe product
body: Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana have each sued OpenAI in their own state courts, Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird said in a release. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company has built age-specific protections that "many other AI products lack."
note: For finance teams, the case is a reminder that a consumer chatbot can draw state court action, which matters for any bank or fintech that puts one in front of customers.

evidence.text: Eight states filed lawsuits against OpenAI on Wednesday alleging that the artificial intelligence company's ChatGPT chatbot is an unsafe product that's harmed children and deceived parents.
Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana have individually sued OpenAI in their own state courts, Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird said in a release .
OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company has built age-specific protections into its product that "many other AI products lack."
